overall.verdict: The mobile dark variant demonstrates strong visual design with excellent visceral value implementation and high trust factors. The design successfully implements the one-scale bar principle and maintains good consistency across screens. However, there are several typography and hierarchy issues that reduce the premium feel and data legibility in certain areas.
priority_fixes: Standardize typography sizes across all screens, particularly for secondary information
Improve hierarchy by reducing redundant information and ensuring the eye lands on the most important data first
Increase contrast and legibility for small text elements
Fix inconsistent spacing and layout patterns
Ensure visual consistency of bars, legends, and tooltips across all screens
